notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Warden of the Eye and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Warden of the Eye and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
